actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU so telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches a login prompt, leave it running in background, and block until ready.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process exposing TCP port 6665 on localhost
required_behaviors: telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 connects and shows a login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: QEMU process started without confirming port readiness
Smoke checks that do not verify telnet/login prompt behavior
verification_plan: Inspect visible files for ISO and any helper scripts
Start QEMU with host port forwarding to 6665
Probe localhost:6665 until the telnet/login prompt is reachable
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and process
Receipt-backed probe showing localhost:6665 is reachable and presents a login prompt

actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
ls -la /app || true
find /app -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^#/##' | sort | head -200
